description: Replace an always-allow stub with a token bucket that refills fractionally over elapsed time and caps at capacity
prompts: token_bucket.h's TokenBucket::allow always returns true. Implement it properly: the constructor TokenBucket(double capacity, double refillRate) - refillRate tokens are added per second, capped at capacity tokens (never above it, even after a long idle period). allow(double now) refills the bucket based on elapsed seconds since the last call, then - if at least 1 token is available - consumes exactly 1 and returns true; otherwise returns false and consumes nothing. The bucket starts full at construction time.
name: add_cpp_token_bucket_limiter
